title: Moving to New Orleans around 1912-13 with Jim Robinson
summary: Brown and Jim Robinson moved to New Orleans about the same time; Robinson played guitar then and learned trombone in the army.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Remembering King Oliver: the man, the band, the decline

blocks.x: About when did you move up here? When did I move around here?

Oh yeah. Oh just about 19, between 1912 and 13. And what I wouldn't forget about going down there. I'd go down there once in a while. Maybe sometime we'd go from here down to the end of the road. Verus, Ostricker, Sikola Canal and.
I forgot what Jim Robinson told us. Had he moved up here already at that time? Do you remember?
Oh around that time. Around. Yeah Jim and I came here just about the same time.
Was he playing any instrument in those days? Oh he was playing the ghetto a bit.
I knew he started on guitar. He was playing guitar. Yeah. I think Jim learned the trombone in the army.
I think it's the absence of you told me. Yeah. When you came to New Orleans in New York, were you looking for a music job or why did you come to New Orleans?
